function doGet(e) {
  try {
    const p = e && e.parameter ? e.parameter : {};

    if (String(p.action || '') === 'email_open') {
      recordEmailOpen_(
        String(p.sid || ''),
        String(p.test || '') === '1'
      );
    }

    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput('ok')
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.TEXT);

  } catch (err) {
  const msg = err && err.stack ? err.stack : String(err);

  console.error('email_open endpoint error:', msg);

  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput('ERROR')
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.TEXT);
}
}
